paragraphs: Garden or Badminton?, posted by Lily. Teacher Kim gave the Explorers a new project for this month. We can choose between two ideas. The first idea is to explore the school garden and make a nature map. The second idea is to learn badminton with Coach Matt. Each project takes four weeks. Every member can write a short opinion under this post.

Mia writes: I choose the garden project, because I love nature. We can explore the garden every Thursday, and I can take photos of the plants. There are many small flowers behind the library. Insects visit them every day. The plants need water, and we can carry it from the tap. It is a shame that nobody looks at our garden. Badminton is fun, but I am a beginner. I am not comfortable with a racket in my hand.

Leo writes: I do not agree with Mia. The garden is nice, but we can see it every day. A garden is nice, but a court is fun. I played once with my dad, and I loved it. I want to move after a long day at school. Badminton is new for us, and it is good exercise. Nearly everybody in our class likes sports. Coach Matt told us, "Beginners are welcome." We can make a team and play on the school court.

May writes: I agree with Mia, and I agree with Leo. Both projects are good, so I cannot choose. Maybe we can do the garden project in November and badminton in December. Then nobody is sad, and everybody has a turn. It is fair, because nobody has to give up a project. Let us ask Teacher Kim, because she knows the school plan. Is that possible, Teacher Kim?

Teacher Kim read all three opinions on Thursday. "May has a good idea," she said. "We will explore the garden first, and then we will learn badminton." Mia smiled, and Leo clapped. Leo found a racket for Mia in the sports room. She held it, and she laughed. Which project do you want to do first?
text.summary: Lily asks the Explorers to choose the next club project, a garden project or badminton. Mia, Leo, and May write their opinions, and they agree or disagree with each other.
